meta.name: alterlab-matchms
meta.description: Computes mass-spectral similarity and identifies compounds for metabolomics with matchms — comparing mass spectra, scoring similarity (cosine, modified cosine), and searching spectral libraries to annotate unknowns. Use when matching MS/MS spectra, identifying metabolites, or library searching; for full LC-MS/MS proteomics pipelines use pyopenms. Part of the AlterLab Academic Skills suite.

copy.tagline: 比对质谱数据并鉴定未知代谢物
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果做代谢组学质谱数据分析，需要比对谱图并鉴定化合物。
copy.tagline_en: Compare mass spectra and identify unknown metabolites
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you analyze metabolomics mass spectrometry data and need to match spectra and identify compounds.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能帮你处理质谱数据：导入多种格式的谱图、过滤和标准化峰、计算谱图相似度（如余弦相似度），并搜索谱库来鉴定未知化合物。
howto.when: 当你需要分析质谱数据（如MS/MS谱图）、比较谱图相似度、或通过谱库搜索鉴定代谢物时触发。

say.text: 帮我加载这个MGF文件，并计算与参考库的余弦相似度。
say.note: Claude会读取文件，计算相似度并返回匹配结果。

say.text: 对这两个谱图应用默认过滤，然后计算修正余弦相似度。
say.note: Claude会先过滤谱图，再计算相似度分数。

say.text: 用ModifiedCosineGreedy找出与查询谱最相似的10个参考谱。
say.note: Claude会排序并返回前10个匹配。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can process mass spectrometry data: import spectra from multiple formats, filter and normalize peaks, compute spectral similarities (e.g., cosine similarity), and search spectral libraries to annotate unknown compounds.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need to analyze mass spectrometry data (e.g., MS/MS spectra), compare spectral similarity, or identify metabolites by searching spectral libraries.

say_en.text: Load this MGF file and compute cosine similarity against a reference library.
say_en.note: Claude will read the file, compute similarity, and return matches.

say_en.text: Apply default filters to these two spectra, then compute modified cosine similarity.
say_en.note: Claude will filter spectra first, then calculate similarity scores.

say_en.text: Use ModifiedCosineGreedy to find the top 10 reference spectra most similar to the query.
say_en.note: Claude will sort and return the top 10 matches.
